thread:
maria.ae: Acme Fin asks for a 3-week POC: document Q&A + reranking and a tool call to fetch balances. Need success criteria, model choice (32k vs embeddings+rerank), and hosted vs dedicated pricing for 50k queries.

ben.se: Clarify context need: full doc 32k or chunk+embed? That affects cost heavily.

maria.ae: They want paragraph-level citations and said they will upload full monthly statements. Prefer hosted if possible.

jordan.ml: Paragraph citations are easiest with a 32k context model. Embeddings+rerank is cheaper and can be more precise but requires indexing and returns chunk refs. Trade-offs: latency, exact-match behavior, and attribution.

lisa.cs: Security checklist: SAML SSO, KMS-managed keys, 90-day audit logs, and EU data residency (eu-west-1). Any hosted blockers?

ben.se: Hosted supports SAML and KMS on enterprise plans; region pinning possible but need DPA/SOC2 confirmation. Dedicated gives clearer residency guarantee.

maria.ae: They also need tool calling to an internal API that requires client-cert mTLS. Can hosted do mTLS?

lisa.cs: mTLS with client certs is only supported in Private/VPC deployments. Hosted can make outbound HTTPS calls but cannot present client certs. Dedicated/private resolves that.

maria.ae: Mark that as a hosted blocker. We'll include Dedicated option.

jordan.ml: Proposed acceptance criteria: 1) >=90% exact-match on 200 eval prompts, 2) p50 E2E latency <=800ms warm (<=1.5s cold), 3) reranker improves top-1 precision >=15% vs embeddings-only, 4) toolcall success >=98% with graceful fallback. Measure cold/warm and attribution accuracy.

ben.se: Cost calc: 50k queries * ~800 tokens =~40M tokens. Option A: host rw-infer-gpt-32k; Option B: chunk+embed+rerank; Option C: Dedicated reserved pool. I'll model two hosted scenarios and a dedicated ballpark including expected drivers (context length, batching, KV cache).

jordan.ml: I'll run a 1k-sample embedding+rerank sim to estimate top1 lift and latency. Reranker design: ANN recall (faiss) -> top-k rerank with a small decoder; test toolcall failure modes and fallback behavior.

maria.ae: Can you draft a short eval harness YAML to share with the customer?

jordan.ml: Sure. Example:

# eval_config.yaml
project: acme_poc
eval_set: acme_statements_200
models:
  - rw-infer-gpt-32k
  - rw-infer-gpt-8k_embeddings_rerank
metrics:
  - exact_match
  - top1_precision
  - latency_p50
  - toolcall_success_rate
requests: 200
cache_modes:
  - cold
  - warm

ben.se: Rollout suggestion: week0 prep + synthetic evals, week1 internal demo + small customer sandbox, week2 extended sandbox + load test, week3 go/no-go. Fits 3-week timeline if infra reservation is ready.

lisa.cs: I'll provide DPA snippet, retention language, and confirm SAML+KMS support with legal by EOD tomorrow.

maria.ae: Action items: Ben & Jordan - hosted vs dedicated cost scenarios and initial eval numbers; Lisa - compliance snippet. Ben please cc infra on pricing.

ben.se: Will send cost scenarios today.

jordan.ml: Will post sim results tomorrow AM.

lisa.cs: DPA snippet incoming.

deploy-bot: scheduled-deploy: sandbox cluster reserved for acme-poc on 1975553300.

maria.ae: Thanks, closing loop. :thumbsup:
